content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Other conditions: The post is purely temporary and co-terminates with the project. Desirable: Candidates with prior research experience in seaweed biomass processing, extraction of value-added products and their characterization, handling biomass processing reactor and related assemblies Candidates with prior research publications/patent in algal cultivation/processing, algal biorefinery. Candidates must have proficiency in scientific writing and lab management.

content_sections.heading: GBU Project Scientist I Job Description
content_sections.text: The selected candidate will work under the research project titled "Sustainable Enhancement of Kappaphycus for Climate Resilience and Economic Development through Omics-driven Cultivar Improvement and Value Addition." The post is purely temporary and co-terminates with the project.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Initially for 1 year (extended to next year, subject to satisfactory performance) Total project duration: 2 years
